newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Van Der Horst to invest in satellites.
newsitem.headline: Van Der Horst to invest in satellites.

text.p: Engineering specialist Van Der Horst Ltd said on Tuesday it was investing US$25 million in a satellite company, Space Imaging LP.
Space Imaging currently sells space imagery from the Indian IRS-1C satellite which enables people to resolve objects as small as five metres.
"We see our investment in space imaging as an opportunity to diversify into the space-based information market," said Johannes Kotjo, VDH chairman in the statement.
VDH said it will finance the invesment through internal resources and debt financing. No impact is expected on earnings for financial year ending September 30 1997.
